rr_policy: gross RR >= 1.20 is evaluated from price-level precision; 2-decimal RR is display only; net RR is diagnostic only
event_policy: informational only; no score, signal, BUY/TARGET/STOP or hard-gate effect
display_filter: strategy tabs show raw public S; aggregate eligibility keeps the existing hard gate, then uses a capped research overlay as a soft ranking adjustment
